name: O-DS-AR
author: Codex gpt-6.1-sol ultra

domain.fresh_legal_two_safe_choices: accepted independently by root; not established by this contract

implementation_boundary: i_xbar.gen_mst_port_mux[0].i_axi_mux.gen_mux: replace AR chooser only before existing i_ar_spill_reg

activation_contract.origin: root accepted naturally reachable common state before merged NormalTL firstVALID
activation_contract.inherit: all existing firstVALID locks, full AR payloads, output-spill entries and source/DDR credits; no existing commitment may be reset
activation_contract.rr_pointer: import current native RR pointer at the common cut; subsequent ordinary accepts follow this frozen contract
activation_contract.ds_streak: derive from observed completed shared-AR history with the fixed update/reset rule; an observer required before the cut is charged equally

allowed: current VALID and AR head of each existing per-route cut
existing selected/held source and accepted handshake history
current output-spill ready for handshake accounting only
forbidden: future RREADY or hidden MIG/controller state
F1 double rollout or arbitrary candidate counterfactual

states.rr_pointer: 2 bits; reset 0; next circular scan start after accepted winner

choose_when_unheld: If a non-DS current VALID exists and ds_streak==4, choose the first non-DS VALID in circular RR order from rr_pointer.
Else if DS3 current VALID exists, choose DS3.
Else choose the first current VALID in circular RR order from rr_pointer; if none, emit no VALID.
frozen_rule.first_valid_commit: When emitting chooser VALID, hold winner and all its AR fields until the existing output-spill input handshake; new DS VALID cannot displace a held comp.
after_input_handshake: Set rr_pointer to accepted winner+1 modulo 4 and clear held_valid.
If winner is DS and non-DS VALID was present, increment ds_streak with saturation at 4.
frozen_rule.no_non_ds_pending: Reset ds_streak to 0 when no non-DS current VALID is present; an arriving waiter may wait through at most four newly accepted DS heads.
frozen_rule.while_held: Keep selected payload/VALID stable and update no choice state until the owned handshake; resetting ds_streak when no non-DS is pending does not alter the held choice.

protocol_and_ownership.full_id: 6 bits = source prefix [5:4] + existing source-local ID [3:0]
protocol_and_ownership.shared_R_priority: root-owned complete-run DS priority must preserve same fullID order and every already held first RVALID beat; AR control does not change return policy

fairness.unit: accepted input handshakes at the existing shared AR output-spill boundary
fairness.cpuoff_continuously_valid_comp_bound: after at most four DS acceptances comp gets the next fresh choice; one pre-existing held request may add one acceptance
fairness.continuously_valid_ds_bound: at most one comp input acceptance precedes DS after DS becomes visible, including an inherited comp lock or fixed fairness escape; these cannot accumulate because accepting comp resets ds_streak
fairness.absolute_clock_bound_condition: requires finite downstream service/credit progress; held requests and stalled READY cannot be preempted

covered_delay: Unheld shared AR RR selecting comp while DS is already current VALID, apart from the one frozen fairness escape.
not_covered: PTE birth or its predecessor consume
payload selected before DS becomes visible
DS per-ID demux credit or route-cut backpressure
already accepted DDR mem_q occupancy or ARREADY backpressure
held R and all return-stage waits

cost_contract.native_state_reference: existing rr_tree has RR state2, lock1 and frozen request-vector4; exact mapped incremental area is unmeasured
cost_contract.added_logic: current DS VALID priority, non-DS circular RR selection and fairness comparator/mask, explicit held choice
required_paid_interfaces: four local current-VALID signals and existing AR data at shared mux
existing chooser/output-spill handshakes and held state
all added observation or register/select latency equally charged in complete ordinary/mechanism comparison
cost_contract.if_registered_observe_or_select_needed: Charge all introduced cycles and storage through final whole-job retirement; a software/hierarchical zero-cost peek is not hardware evidence.

acceptance_checks_before_any_performance: Use the same reachable pre-firstVALID origin, native jobs/full IDs/bytes/obligations and complete-run R-priority policy.
Record chooser firstVALID, inherited lock, output-spill input accepts, DDRaccept and phase-relative PTE events, not only final issue time.
Verify stable VALID/AR, no same-fullID reorder and complete W/R/B/fault byte/transaction conservation.
Verify the fixed four-DS fairness bound in accepted opportunities; include any observer/select latency in whole completion.
A gain covered by this single rule does not justify F1 mechanism novelty; no posthoc tuning/rollout substitution.
